turns.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test have been opened?
turns.standalone: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test have been opened?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

turns.question: now only in Alameda county
turns.standalone: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test, that are not virtual and are in Alameda county, have been opened?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T2.County = 'Alameda'

turns.question: what's the average of those scores instead of the count
turns.standalone: What is the average Math SAT score of non-virtual schools in Alameda county with a Math SAT score greater than 400?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T2.County = 'Alameda'

turns.question: List the names and streets of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollment between K-12 and ages 5-17.
turns.standalone: List the names and streets of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollment between K-12 and ages 5-17.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT T1.School, T1.Street FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE ABS(T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30

turns.question: make that difference over 100 instead

turns.question: State the names and full communication address of high schools in Monterey which have a free meal count of over 800 for ages 5-17.
turns.standalone: State the names and full communication address of high schools in Monterey which have a free meal count of over 800 for ages 5-17.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT T1.`School Name`, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'

turns.question: which of those have more than 1000 free meal count
turns.standalone: Among high schools in Monterey with a free meal count of over 800 for ages 5-17, which ones have a free meal count of over 1000 for ages 5-17?

turns.question: never mind the charter part, just tell me how many schools total match the Monterey criteria
